app-templates.message:
docs: one architecture for every archetype, generic at the repo root with an extension per archetype

## Intent

The quiz and the explainer have the same quality goals as interactive apps, so they follow the same architecture. They stay archetypes of their own and extend the generic architecture, as interactive apps do. Being text-heavy, they must also be readable without JavaScript.

## Key changes

- The generic architecture of every lernapps app lives in docs/arc42/: the frame (static description, page trees, 404 page, build checks, shell, end-to-end tests, tooling helpers) with its optional parts (tutor handoff, task numbers, exercise contract, settings, loading indicator) and an abstract archetype part.
- quiz/, explainer/ and interactive/ each get an extension with only the blocks, interfaces, decisions, risks and terms their archetype adds.
- Readable without JavaScript is a quality goal of the quiz and the explainer.
- Each combination of the generic part and one extension validates without errors or warnings.
- The root README points to both parts and says which sub-block does what in each archetype; docs/ is on the pre-push hook's root-only list.
